name: kanonik
description: Security compliance software for your AI. Kanonik makes your AI a compliance expert for policies, controls, risks, vendors, evidence and security questionnaires, and checks every draft before you see it. Only what a named person approves goes into a Record anyone can verify offline. SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, NIST CSF 2.0 and 12 more frameworks.
